name: Dead End Rain
evidence_scope: Current Xenoverse 2-specific mechanics and acquisition evidence.
findings: 2026-09-26 Batch 454 current-evidence enrichment: 300-Ki Ki Blast Ultimate from Expert Mission 13, A History of Mixed Battles. The user rises and fires a long-range overhead barrage downward; current skill evidence documents 22 hits and about 30% damage and characterizes it as wide-area pressure. Android 18 and Android 17 (DB Super) are documented users. Exact projectile timing, spread, scaling, and hit-confirm behavior remain unresolved.
evidence_boundaries: Unsupported exact frames, scaling formulas, probabilities, hidden conditions, and patch-independent balance values were not inferred.
Source-reported numerical values remain bounded evidence.
